name: glute-lacrosse-ball
instructions:
1. In a seated position, place the lacrosse ball directly underneath your glute at the base of your pelvis and lower leg.
2. Cross one leg over the other in a figure four position and shift your weight over the glute of the crossed leg. Drop one hand behind you for support and place the other on the crossed leg.
3. Slowly roll up and down the length of the glute for 20-30 seconds.
4. Repeat on the other side.
